name: Streamlit Dev Container
updateContentCommand: if [ -s packages.txt ]; then sudo apt update && sudo xargs -r apt install -y <packages.txt; fi; if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip3 install --user -r requirements.txt; fi; pip3 install --user --upgrade 'setuptools>=83.0.0'; echo '✅ Packages installed and Requirements met'
postCreateCommand: python3 -m compileall -q app.py && python3 -c "import ast,sys; ast.parse(open('app.py').read()); print('✅ Mark My Words parses cleanly')" && python3 -c "import googleapiclient, docx2txt, gspread, groq, pypdf, supabase, streamlit; print('✅ All runtime imports resolve')"
